recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-40533; future DeviceUsage maintenance belongs in the OO Incubator IG or whichever repository owns DeviceUsage if it returns to core.
issue_request: FHIR-40533 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. The accepted change was to add the missing DeviceUsage status search parameter, while the category/usageReason binding warnings and usageReason/usageStatus naming warnings were explicitly left for future consideration.
initial_application: Git commit 874c8788d9e80ebf43e226bb7a19937a8f8d3607, titled FHIR-40533, added DeviceUsage-status to source/deviceusage/bundle-DeviceUsage-search-params.xml with code status, type token, expression DeviceUsage.status, and DeviceUsage.status path metadata. The retained core source still contains that SearchParameter entry.
additional_context: The current FHIR core build no longer includes DeviceUsage: source/fhir.ini has no active deviceusage=DeviceUsage entry under [resources], and commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed DeviceUsage and related OO resources from core while changing links to the OO Incubator IG. build.fhir.org/deviceusage now returns 404, while the OO Incubator SearchParameter-DeviceUsage-status JSON exposes a token status parameter with expression DeviceUsage.status. OO HCP Confluence minutes from 2023-02-27 corroborate the Jira vote and scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source files were edited because source/deviceusage is out of the current core build scope, and the accepted search parameter is already present in the retained source and in the current external publication surface.
